newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Telecom issues NZ$275 mln capital notes.
newsitem.headline: Telecom issues NZ$275 mln capital notes.

text.p: Telecom Corp of New Zealand Ltd announced on Monday the issue of NZ$275 million of TeleNotes via its subsidiary TCNZ Finance Ltd.

"TeleNotes represent the first rated capital notes issue ever offered in New Zealand and will be rated by both Moody's and Standard and Poor's, the latter rating being AA minus," Telecom said in a statement.
The TeleNotes would be used to finance part of Telecom's NZ$1 billion share repurchase programme, which commenced in February, and would form part of Telecom's capital funds, the company said.

A placement of NZ$225 million of TeleNotes was made on Monday to institutional investors. A further $50 million of the same issue was available for retail investors via a prospectus and application form which would be available on Wednesday, Telecom said.
The TeleNotes issue has a coupon rate of 8.5 percent for an initial term of seven years, at which time the issuer nominates a coupon for a new term.
If the holder chooses redemption, TCNZ Finance will have the option to redeem the notes with cash or Telecom shares.
Interest will be paid twice a year and minimum applications are for NZ$5,000.
"TeleNotes with different terms may be issued at a later date," Telecom said.
Application had been made for the TeleNote issue to be listed on the New Zealand Stock Exchange.
Lead managers for the issue were Credit Suisse First Boston and First NZ Capital.
